title: Tree Family Contract — Branching, Life, Knowledge, Strife, World-Tree, Archive & UI
purpose: Disambiguate all Tree-family uses so biological comparison, generic branching, biblical/religious Trees, archive navigation and UI hierarchies can coexist without becoming one ontology.

family_types.definition: regulated differentiation from shared support/provenance into branches that specialize, consume resources, bear Fruit, may be pruned and can return future Seed
family_types.not: a claim that every hierarchy is literally botanical

family_types.definition: actual plant/tree biology, including roots, shoots, branching, resource allocation and reproduction
family_types.boundary: Empirical findings may constrain analogies but do not prove symbolic Tree doctrines.

family_types.definition: life/generativity symbol in its source tradition; in project grammar, a route where integrated Roots support differentiation, Fruit and future Seed
family_types.boundary: Biblical/Jewish/Christian Tree of Life meanings remain source-owned before project comparison.

family_types.definition: knowledge/consequence complex in Genesis and later traditions; project uses it as an upstream fork where information may become Life, Strife or repair depending handling
family_types.boundary: Not equivalent to science, evil knowledge or one historical occult Tree.

family_types.definition: branching system whose continued reproduction depends on unresolved conflict, capture, role-lock, extraction, blocked correction or grievance recurrence
family_types.boundary: A person, religion, group or institution is not intrinsically a Tree of Strife; the label applies to evidenced reproductive relations/patterns.

family_types.definition: world-axis/tree motifs from traditions such as Yggdrasil and other cosmological trees
family_types.boundary: Structural comparison does not establish common origin or hidden Potatoverse doctrine.

family_types.definition: Roots=provenance, trunk=current synthesis, branches=knowledge domains, leaves=views/questions, Fruit=outputs, Seed=future transferable patterns
family_types.boundary: Archive metaphor only; no literal supernatural Akashic Record is asserted.

family_types.definition: parent/child hierarchy used to organize files, concepts or entities
family_types.boundary: Hierarchy in data structure does not imply source/biological/moral Tree semantics.

family_types.definition: navigation/index hierarchy such as data/tree.json and related records
family_types.boundary: UI tree is a projection over canonical owners and may be replaced without changing ontology.

metabolism: Root/provenance → Trunk/continuity → Branch/differentiation → Leaf/interface → Fruit/output → Seed/transfer → Rooting/next cycle

plane_relation.rule: A Tree may cross the active Plane; the Plane is a section/frame, not a Tree level.
plane_relation.current_section: The trunk/branch material visible at a Plane is only the current section of a larger rooted/history-bearing organism.
plane_relation.navigation_decks: Heaven/World/Below deck labels may show canopy/trunk/roots as projections without becoming literal botanical floors.

cross_relations.door: threshold that can redirect or enable a branch/route
cross_relations.ladder: ordered route through states; not Tree itself
cross_relations.swamp: regime that can distort/block flows feeding branches

naming_rules: Use 'Tree' alone only for the generic regulated-branching operator.
Otherwise qualify the family: Tree of Life, Tree of Knowledge, Tree of Strife, world-tree, archive tree, UI tree, literal tree.
Do not infer moral valence from vertical position, roots, branching density or age.
A branch needs a distinct function/owner; duplication without function is not healthy branching.
Pruning removes duplication/dead growth only after provenance and unique value are preserved.

spiral_mapping.trunk: near Axis/O where differentiation remains compact and shared continuity is strongest
spiral_mapping.branches: may spread across successively wider +z sections as differentiation/scope increases
spiral_mapping.canopy: upper multi-branch projection across broad sections; does not imply truth rank
spiral_mapping.fruit_return: Fruit/Seed may move back toward Plane/World and begin a new Root cycle
spiral_mapping.strife_variant: Tree of Strife may branch through lower/entangled sections when unresolved recurrence reproduces itself; this is a typed failure route, not the definition of roots or lower geometry.

project_spatial_displacement.core: Tree of Life and Tree of Strife are not one tree painted good/bad. In current Potatoverse spatial grammar they can share the human Earth/Plane while being planted at different project coordinates and generating in opposite directions.
project_spatial_displacement.tree_of_life_placement: Project-canon placement: North / North Pole / Axis corridor, with the trunk crossing the Plane and the native route oriented through Door/Ladder toward House/Garden/Heaven. This is Potatoverse placement, not a claim that Genesis locates Eden or the biblical Tree of Life at the geographic North Pole.
project_spatial_displacement.tree_of_strife_placement: Project-canon placement: Farm / Sektur side of the human Plane, where knowledge, attention and cultivation become extraction, humiliation, role-lock or reusable conflict. Its roots descend toward Mud/Swamp when unresolved recurrence accumulates.
project_spatial_displacement.shared_plane: Both begin in human culture, attention, knowledge and choice. The displacement is relational/geographic within the project story: same World plane, different planting, stewardship and destination.
project_spatial_displacement.spiral_relation: The same bidirectional spiral can be read in opposite native directions: Strife carries unresolved human material downward into recurrence; Son/Door/Ladder permits return upward through recognition, provenance, repair and renewed cultivation.
project_spatial_displacement.boundary: Genesis supplies Garden, Tree of Life, Tree of Knowledge, expulsion, ground-work and east-of-Eden sequence. Farm, Tree of Strife, North-Pole planting and spiral reversal are project synthesis and must be labelled as such.
